challengeTitle: Clean Up a Heavily Littered Public Area
challengeDescription: Remove accumulated plastic waste, trash, and other debris from a heavily polluted public area. Provide before-and-after photographs showing the same location with a visible reduction in litter and improved cleanliness.
submissionDescription: Our cleanup team removed large amounts of plastic waste, bags, bottles, and other scattered garbage from a heavily littered open area near a bridge. The before photo shows extensive waste covering the ground, while the after photo shows the area largely cleared, with cleanup volunteers present.
